watch.definition: A period of time (4 or 2 hours) during which some of a ship's crew are on duty.

hour-hand.definition: The shorter of a clock’s two hands indicates the current hour.

minute-hand.definition: The longer hand on an analog clock indicates the number of minutes past the hour.

second-hand.definition: The thin hand on an analog clock or watch that shows seconds.
second-hand.exampleUsage: The second hand moved once around the clock face.

clock-face.definition: The front of a clock presents the time using numbers, tick marks, hands, or a digital display.

digital-clock.definition: An electronic clock that displays the hour and minute as numbers instead of using hands on a dial.

sundial.definition: Timepiece that indicates the daylight hours by the shadow that the gnomon casts on a calibrated dial.

hourglass.definition: A sandglass that runs for sixty minutes.

minute.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

half-hour.exampleUsage: The lesson lasts half an hour.

quarter-hour.exampleUsage: A quarter hour is fifteen minutes.

dusk.definition: The time of day immediately following sunset.

twilight.definition: The time of day immediately following sunset.

o-clock.definition: Used after a number to state an exact hour on the clock.
o-clock.exampleUsage: The meeting starts at three o'clock.

half-past.definition: Thirty minutes after a stated hour.

quarter-past.definition: Fifteen minutes after a stated hour.

quarter-to.definition: Fifteen minutes before the next stated hour.

five-past.definition: Five minutes after a stated hour.

ten-past.definition: Ten minutes after a stated hour.

twenty-past.definition: Twenty minutes after a stated hour.

five-to.definition: Five minutes before the next stated hour.

ten-to.definition: Ten minutes before the next stated hour.

morning.definition: The time period between dawn and noon.

afternoon.definition: The part of the day between noon and evening.

evening.definition: The latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall).

night.definition: The time between sunset and midnight.

sunrise.definition: The time when the sun first appears in the sky.

sunset.definition: The time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon.

late-night.definition: The period near the end of the evening or during the first hours after midnight.
late-night.exampleUsage: The last program is shown late at night.

early-morning.definition: The part of the day between the middle of the night and sunrise, usually beginning around four o’clock and continuing briefly after dawn as darkness gives way to daylight.

nightfall.definition: The time of day immediately following sunset.

a-m-.definition: A number that keeps another number the same when you add it.

p-m-.definition: A number that keeps another number the same when you add it.

on-time.definition: Arriving on time means reaching a place at the agreed or expected moment.

early.definition: At or near the beginning of a period of time or course of events or before the usual or expected time.

ahead-of-time.definition: It refers to doing something earlier than the customary or anticipated time.

behind-schedule.definition: Later than the planned time or not progressing as quickly as planned.
behind-schedule.exampleUsage: The train was ten minutes behind schedule.

countdown.definition: Counting backward from an arbitrary number to indicate the time remaining before some event (such as launching a space vehicle).

stopwatch.definition: A watch that measures how long an activity takes.
